name: CENNETIC V850L Vertical Machining Center
summary: The V850L is a versatile 850 mm-travel vertical machining center for general-purpose milling of prismatic parts.
body:
The V850L is a versatile 850 mm-travel vertical machining center for general-purpose milling of prismatic parts.

Technical specifications

ItemUnitSpec
Spindle1pcsJCT (Taiwan)
Screw bearing6setFAG/BSB
Ball screw3setHIWIN
Coupling3setRunde
Linear guideway3setHIWIN (Taiwan)
Tool Magazine1setOKADA (Taiwan)
System1setTaiwanSyntec/Mitsubishi
Motor4setJapanSyntec/Mitsubishi
Lubrication system1setHoval
Telescopic cover3setHongwang/Aipai'er

About this model

This Vertical Machining Center is manufactured by our partner factory in Dongguan, China, and supplied direct by CENNETIC with factory-direct pricing, a standard warranty and remote setup support. Specifications are representative and can be confirmed against your machining requirements before order.
